scope: Legacy and isolated EAS indexer failure reporting

behavior.recipient_failures: Provider response/exception details are not placed in chain status, ingestion audit, or scheduler output. Failed recipients retain only the public address prefix and exception class.
behavior.outbox_failures: The legacy indexer preserves OutboxEnqueueError type and rollback behavior while replacing its message with a fixed summary.
behavior.persistence_failures: The isolated worker uses fixed persistence summaries and suppresses chained database exception text.

focused_checks.command: .venv/bin/python -s -m pytest tests/test_eas_provider.py tests/test_eas_worker.py tests/test_eas_indexer_recovery.py tests/test_scheduled_command_contracts.py tests/test_worker_operation_map.py -q
coverage: provider exception redaction from isolated chain status and scheduler error
provider exception redaction from legacy status, ingestion audit, and logs
fixed outbox failure message with rollback preserved
persistence wrapper suppresses raw exception context
EAS pagination, cursor, worker, scheduled-command, and operation-map contracts

limitations: No live EAS endpoint or database was used.
Historical provider reorg, late-arrival, and offset-pagination behavior remain open.
The isolated worker remains default-off pending owner schedule reconciliation and credential provisioning.
